name: Idea
text: While buying, exert this to count as 1 idea.

name: Quarry
text: Gain 1 stone.

name: Study
text: Exert any number of other cards from your hand. Gain that many (ideas).

name: Survey
text: Choose one: put up to 2 of your market cards on the bottom of your draft pool and reveal that many replacements; or hold 1 market card into next round.

name: Labor Gang
text: Gain 2 (stone).

name: Scholar
text: Draw 2 cards.

name: Smelt
text: You may pay 2 stone: gain 1 iron.

name: Recall
text: Return up to 2 exerted cards to your hand.
role: Reuse Quarry, Study or Idea cards

name: Carve
text: You may pay 3 iron: gain 1 marble.

name: Demolish
text: Pay 2 iron: exile an event on the track.
role: Answer to burying and key events

name: Stone Pit
text: Start: gain 2 (stone).

name: Market Square
text: Start: reveal 1 more card into your market.

name: Forge
text: Start: you may pay 2 stone: gain 1 iron.

name: Library
text: Start: draw 1 card.

name: Granary
text: Start: resources gained from the next event are permanent instead of temporary.
role: Booster; helps whoever owns the next event

name: Echo
text: Start: resolve the previous event's Start effect as if you owned it.

name: Embargo
text: Start: negate the next event.
role: Sabotage that waits at the end of the track

name: Guild Hall
text: Start: gain 1 (idea) for each of your events in an unbroken run directly before this one.

name: Mine
text: Start: gain 1 (iron).

name: Workshop
text: Activate: exert 1 card from your hand to gain 1 (iron).

name: Usurp
text: May be built on top of any event, burying it. Start: gain 1 (stone).

name: Mason's Lodge
text: Start: you may pay 2 iron: gain 1 marble.

name: Monument
text: Building this wins the game.
